response.sql: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), playlist_average AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM playlist_counts) SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, pc.track_count / NULLIF(pa.avg_track_count, 0) AS ratio FROM playlist_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN playlist_average AS pa ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
